# Start Here
New to the setting? These are the basics you need to play a believable character, whoever you are. Everything else in the Lore section is optional reading.
## The Setting - It is the early 2180s. Humanity has settled hundreds of worlds, but most colonies are small, isolated and months away from help. - Three superpowers compete for the frontier: the [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"] (UA), the [textlink="Union of Progressive Peoples" link="CMUGuideLoreUPP"] (UPP) and the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"] (TWE). They are not at open war, but tensions are high and border clashes are common. - Megacorporations, above all [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] (W-Y), are nearly as powerful as governments and own much of the frontier. - Colonists who are tired of being ignored or exploited have taken up arms, most notably the [textlink="Colonial Liberation Front" link="CMUGuideLoreCLF"] (CLF).
## Who You Might Be Every character has an [bold]allegiance[/bold], and it shapes who they trust and what they want. - [bold]Soldiers[/bold]: riflemen, medics, officers and specialists of a national military, such as the [textlink="United States Colonial Marines" link="CMUGuideLoreUSCM"] (USCM), the [textlink="UPP Naval Infantry" link="CMUGuideLoreOrgUPPNI"] or the [textlink="Royal Marine Commandos" link="CMUGuideLoreOrgRMC"] (RMC). You follow orders and military law, and serve your nation's interests, not the colony's. - [bold]Colonists[/bold]: the miners, workers, doctors, administrators and families who live on the colony. It is your home. You want to survive, get paid and be left alone, and you may not like anyone who shows up with guns. - [bold]Corporate staff[/bold]: employees and liaisons of a corporation. You look after your company's interests and property, whatever anyone else thinks. - [bold]Law enforcement[/bold]: colonial police and the [textlink="Colonial Marshal Bureau" link="CMUGuideLoreCMB"] (CMB), keeping order and upholding colonial law. - [bold]Insurgents[/bold]: colonists fighting for independence. To the governments you are terrorists; to many colonists you are freedom fighters.
## Allegiances Your allegiance is picked in character creation and decides which nation or group your character comes from. - [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"] (UA): people of North, Central and South America and their colonies. - [textlink="Union of Progressive Peoples" link="CMUGuideLoreUPP"] (UPP): citizens of the socialist superpower, loyal to the party. - [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"] (TWE): subjects of the Anglo-Japanese empire. - [textlink="Central Confederation of Africa" link="CMUGuideLoreCCA"] (CCA): citizens of the African coalition and its colonies. - [textlink="Independent" link="CMUGuideLoreICSC"] (ICSC): people of the Independent Core System Colonies, answering to none of the superpowers. - [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] (W-Y): people whose first loyalty is to the Company. - [textlink="Colonial Liberation Front" link="CMUGuideLoreCLF"] (CLF): colonists who back the fight for independence. - [bold]Non-Aligned[/bold]: free traders, drifters, colonists and the desperate, loyal to no banner.
## What Your Character Knows - Your [bold]lore primer[/bold] in the character menu tells you the date, where you are, who is present and what threats you might face. Read it every round. - Ordinary people know about the superpowers, the corporations and the insurgencies. That is everyday news. - [textlink="Xenomorphs" link="CMUGuideLoreAliens"] and other alien life are [bold]not common knowledge[/bold]. Officially they don't exist, and most people have never heard of them. Don't act like you know what they are unless your character has a reason to. - [textlink="Synthetics" link="CMUGuideLoreSynthetics"] are common and look human. Many people distrust them.
## Everyday Life - The frontier is brutal and unforgiving. Accidents, disease, violence and things far worse claim lives every day, and death can come at any turn. - Colonists live under [textlink="colonial law" link="AU14CCLaw"], while soldiers answer to the [textlink="Uniform Code of Military Justice" link="AU14UCMJ"] (UCMJ) and [textlink="Military SOP" link="AU14SOP"].
## Want To Know More? - [textlink="Factions" link="CMUGuideLoreFactions"]: who's who on the frontier. - [textlink="Organisms" link="CMUGuideLoreOrganisms"]: what's out there in the dark. - [textlink="Technologies" link="CMUGuideLoreTechnologies"]: the machines that keep humanity alive among the stars. - [textlink="Locations" link="CMUGuideLoreLocations"]: the maps, the Neroid Sector and the colonies where your story takes place.
